verdict.rationale: Plausible's self-hosted Community Edition lets users run the entire stack on infrastructure of their choosing, effectively giving full control over data location, and its GDPR-focused, no-personal-data design (comm-10, comm-11) supports privacy-conscious deployment. However, there is no evidence of an explicit region/residency selection feature within the hosted SaaS product itself (e.g., choosing EU vs US data centers), so residency control is only achieved indirectly via self-hosting.
